name: Viking® 5 Series 15" 39 lb. Panel Ready Clear Ice Machine with Drain Pump
shortDescription: The Viking 15" clear ice machine produces up to 39 lbs. of 3/4” clear ice per day and stores up to 28 lbs. of clear ice. It features an elegant midnight black interior and includes an ice scoop. *CUSTOM PANEL & HANDLE SOLD SEPARATELY* *IMAGE MAY NOT REFLECT FINAL PRODUCT*

features.text: BrightShield™ antimicrobial lighting creates a more hygienic environment for ice
Produces up to 39 lbs. of 3/4” clear ice per day

Accepts 3/4” or 5/8” custom panels or accessory door panel kits
Reversible soft-close door allows for right or left swing
Professional Door Panel features the iconic Viking handle for true design integrity
Classic Door Panel features a slim handle that coordinates with any kitchen design
